description: Prove a suspected vulnerability in the user's own code with a minimal, local proof-of-concept test that fails while the vulnerability exists, then fix it and keep the test as a regression guard. Use when the user asks to confirm, reproduce, or write a proof of concept or exploit test for a vulnerability finding in their own project, for example from kit-security-audit. Do not use against third-party systems, production, or hosts the user does not own, for finding vulnerabilities in the first place (use kit-security-audit), or for non-security bugs (use kit-debugging).
